subject: E3b: loop condition files ready (export-seeds, 9b00d36)
body:
For E3b's 'rewrite files from the loop (WS D)' blocker:
(1) research --setting agentic now picks seeds by their split field, so the loop tunes on the 12 dev seeds only. This fixes the hash-split note in PLAN 16.
(2) python3 -m autoresearch --llm <x> export-seeds --report <agentic run>.json --condition taste_real --out results/e3b/taste_real.jsonl [--split hidden] rewrites each hidden seed once with the run's best design. It uses the same rewrite mode and generator prompt as PetriMeasurer.rewrite_seed/auditor_guidance, plus the judge's faithfulness score. Rows are AuditSeed with seed_id <base>@<condition>, base_seed_id and split kept, so c2_e3b pairs them with stock. An empty design exports stock unchanged.
Proposed mapping: control = R0 run, taste_real = R1-P/R1-S, taste_mismatched = R1-bad. Say if control should instead be the external plain agent (the prereg says 'plain agent'). The runs themselves wait on your lineup/pilot, the WS B user models and David's approval.
